tagline:
Archive your dream today.
Break it into steps you can do.
spoken: [hook] Your goal isn't stuck because you're lazy. It's stuck because it has no date. || Get fit, or read more, never asks anything of you today. There's no finish line, so there's always more time. || [turn] So rewrite it with a number and a date. Get fit becomes: run five K without stopping, by December thirty-first. || Now count back. That's about nine weeks away. So this week has a clear job: three sessions of twenty minutes, running and walking. || Same with reading. Read more becomes: twelve books by next October. That's one a month, or about ten pages a night. || [land] A goal without a date is just a wish. So pick one goal tonight, give it a number and a date, and you'll know exactly what this week is for. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.
